'''Langstrom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during [[3642 BBY]]. While preparing for the assault on the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] at the [[Sundari Flatlands]], Langstrom's squad was attacked by mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid's]] from a nearby laboratory. After Langstrom was killed, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tenn (sergeant)|Tenn]] took over as the commanding officer and retreated with what remained of the squad, before calling for reinforcements.
